decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Photo, Heritage Statement, Planning Statement, Proposed Gate and Fence Drawing, Sheet 2, Second Location Plan, Existing Wall and Gate Drawing, received 04/11/11. Explanatory email received 19/12/11.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects
description: Replacement of the existing front boundary dwarf wall and erection of a timber fence and gate to the house
